declaration.preface:
BR Agrotech Limited fosters a workplace that prioritizes fairness, safety, and inclusivity. We recognize that ethical labor practices and human rights protection are essential to ensuring the well-being of employees, building trust with stakeholders, and maintaining business sustainability. By adhering to international labor standards and best practices, we aim to create a work environment that upholds dignity, equality, and respect for all.

This policy establishes our commitments to workplace safety, fair wages, equal opportunities, and non-discrimination while ensuring compliance with national and international labor regulations. Through proactive engagement, regular monitoring, and continuous improvement, we work towards strengthening our labor practices, eliminating any form of workplace exploitation, and fostering a culture of accountability and inclusivity.
declaration.declaration: BR Agrotech Limited is committed to fair labor practices and the protection of human rights in all aspects of its operations. We adhere to the International Labour Organization (ILO) standards, ensuring a safe, inclusive, and respectful workplace for all employees and stakeholders. This policy reinforces our dedication to ethical labor practices, equitable working conditions, and compliance with national and global labor laws.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to BR Agrotech Limited’s operations, and it covers following sites and all its employees, workers, subcontractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Training, skill development, and career growth
Child labor and forced labor prevention
Ethical supply chains and responsible sourcing

Workplace safety and employee well-being: Maintain a safe and healthy work environment.

Enhance employee well-being by introducing stress management workshops and strengthen workplace safety culture by conducting regular risk assessments and implementing proactive hazard prevention measures.
Expand employee welfare programs, including health insurance, parental leave, and financial wellness initiatives.
Fair wages and working hours: Ensure fair wages, reasonable working hours, and a workplace free from discrimination or harassment.
Strictly follow Anti-Discrimination measures and maintain fair wages and working hours in line with national labor laws.
Non-discrimination and anti-harassment: Ensure fair wages, reasonable working hours, and a workplace free from discrimination or harassment.
Foster an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities and fair representation.
Focus on inclusive hiring practices and equal growth opportunities for underrepresented groups.
Employee communication and grievance mec: Promote open communication between employees and management.
Maintain structured communication framework to promote transparent discussions between employees and management.
Ensure implementation of structured grievance mechanisms across all sites and to address 100% grievances within the designated resolution timeline by FY 2029-30.
Prohibit retaliation against employees who report workplace grievances or unethical practices.
Training, skill development, and career: Offer equal opportunities for skill development, training, and career growth.
Introduce leadership development programs to prepare employees for managerial roles.
To follow structured training framework to support employee skill enhancement and career progression.
Child labor and forced labor prevention: Maintain zero tolerance for child labor and forced labor through stringent monitoring and ethical sourcing policies.
Diversity, inclusion, and equal opportun: Foster an inclusive workplace with equal opportunities and fair representation.
Increase the female workforce representation by 15% and ensure equitable leadership representation by FY 2029-30.
Focus on inclusive hiring practices and equal growth opportunities for underrepresented groups.
Freedom of association: Respect employees' rights to form and join trade unions or other worker organizations.
Transparent and compliant hiring practic: Ensure that hiring practices are transparent, free from discrimination, and compliant with labor laws.
Employee benefits and social protections: Provide adequate employee benefits, including health insurance, maternity/paternity leave, and other social protections.
Ethical supply chains and responsible so: Enforce a zero-tolerance policy and conduct supplier audits to ensure compliance.
Ensure ethical labor practices across supply chains through due diligence and engagement.
To strengthen due diligence mechanisms to ensure suppliers adhere to human rights and fair labor practices.
Conduct supplier audits annually to ensure full compliance with child and forced labor regulations.
Collaborate with 3 NGOs by FY 2029-30 to promote ethical labor standards.

targets.target: Maintain zero workplace incidents till FY 2029-30 through targeted training, risk mitigation strategies and hence maintain compliance with occupational health and safety standards across all operations.
Conduct annual employee satisfaction surveys with 80% positive response rate on workplace conditions by FY 2029-30.
Conduct annual anti-harassment & anti-discrimination training for 100% of employees.
Ensure implementation of structured grievance mechanisms across all sites and to address 100% grievances within the designated resolution timeline by FY 2029-30.

policy.monitoring:
The Human Resources Team will track key labor and human rights indicators, conduct regular internal assessments, and report progress annually to senior management and relevant stakeholders. These reports will provide insights into compliance status, areas for improvement, and corrective actions taken to ensure continuous adherence to labor and human rights standards.

Independent third-party audits and assessments are conducted periodically to validate compliance with labor regulations, identify gaps, and recommend improvements. These assessments will also help strengthen accountability and transparency in labor practices.
policy.reviewMechanism: This policy will be reviewed once in the two years or as needed by the Site Head to integrate emerging best practices, align with updated labor laws, and ensure continuous improvement in fair labor standards. Any necessary amendments will be approved by senior management and communicated to all employees and stakeholders.
